about_the_game:
Numeral Strike is a turn-based roguelite where every battle unfolds on a grid of numbers and pairs! Victory depends on your sharp eye and your ability to think ahead!

Features:

  • A unique combat system unlike any other roguelite

    Use the number grid to perform actions — find matching pairs or pairs that add up to 10. Every valid pair lets you attack, heal, defend, or trigger powerful special effects.

  • A variety of unique foes to face

    Enemies shape the battlefield as much as you do! Each one demands thoughtful tactics and a fresh approach to win. Get ready for true duels against the most cunning villains!

  • Chapter-based structure

    No more losing all your progress in a single long run — this roguelite takes a different path! The game is divided into chapters, each with its own unique theme. One chapter pits you against goblins, the next throws you into battle with the undead, and later — with deadly mages. With each chapter, enemies grow stronger and offer new kinds of challenges. And your progress is saved between chapters!

So what are you waiting for? Dive into a vibrant world of medieval adventure as a mercenary hero: carve your path through increasingly challenging enemies, discover powerful artifacts, and craft your strategy for every foe — every turn!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and higher
  • Processor: 4GHz
  • Graphics: GLES3, OpenGL 3.3 and Vulcan compatible
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 9.0c compatible

short_description: A turn-based roguelite where battles take place on a field of numbers. Find pairs — either matching numbers or those that add up to 10 — to attack, defend, and overcome enemies in a world of magical medieval fantasy!
supported_languages: English, Russian, Italian, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
